title: headset-firmware-re device.yaml
description: Structured summary of one device folder (devices/<vendor>-<model>/). Only name, vendor and usb are required; leave out what you do not know. See CONTRIBUTING.md.

name.description: Marketing name as printed on the box.

oem.description: Design house / ODM, if known (e.g. from PCB silkscreen or FCC exhibits).

fcc_id.description: FCC ID(s) for the headset and/or wireless receiver.

platform.description: Folder name under platforms/ when the MCU/SoC + bootloader family is shared with other devices.

vid_pid.description: Lower-case, as lsusb prints it, e.g. "03f0:05b7".

firmware_version.description: Version this identity reports (vendor app, bcdDevice, or a version query).

report_descriptor_lengths.description: HID report descriptor length in bytes, one entry per interface number starting at 0; 0 for a non-HID interface (such as USB Audio Control or AudioStreaming).

mcu.description: Main microcontroller(s) or wireless audio SoC(s).

audio.description: Dedicated DAC, ADC, codec, DSP, USB audio bridge, or amplifier chips (if separate from the main MCU/SoC).

file.description: File name only. The file itself is never committed.

url.description: Official download (page) the outermost package came from.

inside.description: Path from the downloaded package to this file, e.g. "Setup.exe > payload.zip (password X)".

preserve.description: true = tools must never erase or write this region (bootloader, pairing keys, acoustic/ANC calibration, unit-specific data).

protocol.description: Transport and command set, or a link to the platforms/ spec.

entry.description: How the device gets into the bootloader (command, magic word, button chord, pads).

docs.description: Markdown files in this device folder (relative paths).

source.description: verified: what you ran/read and when (command + date, file + address, photo URL). inferred: what it is inferred from. unknown: what would settle it.

marking.description: Text printed on the package, exactly as read.

component.description: Which board this is about. Default: headset.
